summary: All 6 E2E cases are mapped with correct test function naming, confirmed routes/selectors from index.vue and conftest, and factory-first data setup via tests/e2e/adapters. .aa/data-knowledge.yaml exists and resolves domain_factories plus adapters.e2e. Non-blocking warnings cover menu-navigation preference (001), permission-denial UX branching (006), refresh global side effects (005), legacy TC_APIM prefix migration, and compose_limited_role vs registered e2e_seed_limited_user. Minor assertion gaps for create/delete success toasts (002, 004) mirror prior benchmark implementation and do not block codegen.

findings.message: TC_APIS_E2E_002 case requires a create success toast (保存成功提示出现), but Assertion Strategy maps only dialog close, row visibility, and absence of error dialog.
findings.suggestion: Add an optional success-toast assertion (or document dialog-close plus row visibility as accepted proxy) in e2e-plan.md Assertion Strategy and e2e-codegen-plan.md Assertion Mapping for TC_APIS_E2E_002.

findings.message: TC_APIS_E2E_004 case requires a delete success toast (删除成功提示出现), but Assertion Strategy maps only popconfirm visibility and row absence after confirm.
findings.suggestion: Add an optional delete-success toast assertion (or document row-absence as accepted proxy) in e2e-plan.md and e2e-codegen-plan.md for TC_APIS_E2E_004.

findings.message: Limited-user setup uses inline compose_limited_role in conftest while .aa/data-knowledge.yaml registers adapters.e2e.auth.seed_limited_user; behavior is equivalent but transport differs from the registered adapter symbol.
findings.suggestion: Document in codegen comments that compose_limited_role(api_infos=[], menu_ids=[]) is the chosen path; optionally migrate to e2e_seed_limited_user in a follow-up without blocking this change.

findings.message: Existing tests/e2e/test_api_e2e.py uses TC_APIM_E2E_* prefix and change-id RET-api-management-20260716-163247-cursor; codegen targets test_api_management_e2e.py with TC_APIS_E2E_* naming.
findings.suggestion: Regenerate test_api_management_e2e.py per mapping table and retire or supersede test_api_e2e.py traceability header during codegen.

needs_review.question: Confirm sidebar menu labels (系统管理 → API管理) match the running frontend i18n for TC_APIS_E2E_001 menu-navigation flow.
needs_review.reason: Case steps prefer menu navigation; direct URL is supported as fallback but menu labels must match seeded frontend.

needs_review.question: Confirm acceptable permission-denial UX for TC_APIS_E2E_006: redirect to /404 versus permission-masked shell without operable CRUD controls.
needs_review.reason: Product may implement either branch; plan accepts both following prior role/menu E2E patterns but human should confirm scope.

needs_review.question: Confirm no teardown is required after TC_APIS_E2E_005 refresh despite global API registry mutation.
needs_review.reason: Refresh syncs app.routes and may delete orphan DB rows; plan documents side effects but does not assert row counts.
